archiving.description: Archiving format for remote transfers; valid values: 'none', 'tar', 'tgz', 'tbz2', 'txz'.

cache_path_pattern.description: Pattern for per-host cache subdirectory paths; supports %N, %h, %P and datetime directives (see man 5 cdist).

conf_dir.description: List of configuration directories to search (colon-separated in config file, list items in values).

init_manifest.description: Default initial manifest path (empty uses internal default).

jobs.description: Max number of parallel jobs within a host (-1 = auto, 0 = disabled, positive = fixed).

local_shell.description: Shell command for local script execution.

out_path.description: Local output directory for cdist output.

parallel.description: Max number of hosts processed in parallel (-1 = auto, 0 = disabled, positive = fixed).

remote_copy.description: Command for remote copy (should behave like scp).

remote_exec.description: Command for remote exec (should behave like ssh).

remote_shell.description: Shell command for remote script execution.

save_output_streams.description: Whether to save output streams from type executions.
